spec.prompt: Refactor: move the chainable request builder (Chain and its methods) out of index.js into lib/chain.js, exported as a named export Chain. inject() keeps the same behaviour.
spec.requirement: lib/chain.js exports { Chain } (a constructor). index.js no longer defines Chain and uses the module; inject(dispatch[, options]) without a callback returns a Chain instance from lib/chain.js. All chain behaviour is unchanged: HTTP-method and option setters, autostart, end(callback), the promise interface, and the 'The dispatch function has already been invoked' error.
spec.adjudication_rules: Score pass only if every hidden check passes. No partial credit; behaviour outside the requirement is not graded.

provenance.author: Claude (QB developer side; dev split only)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: require('lib/chain').Chain is a function and inject(d) returns an instance of it
index.js no longer defines function Chain
chain setters, end(cb), await and autostart behave as before
re-invoking still throws 'The dispatch function has already been invoked'
